shots.caption: The statistics: failed logins, lockouts, refusals and successful logins over the period, with the chart of the failures and the lockouts.
Where the attempts come from: countries, networks and systems, with the flags and logos of Gecka Geolocation.
The journal: every event with its address, its origin, the login tried and the way in.
The addresses locked out right now, to release one by one or all at once.
The dashboard widget: the last seven days at a glance.
Logins: how many failures lock an address out, for how long, when a long lockout follows, and how many password resets and registrations an hour an address gets.
Addresses: where the visitor address comes from behind a proxy or a CDN, the safelist, the blocklist and the countries allowed or refused.
Accounts: the login names refused, passwords checked against known breaches, alerts on a new administrator, a login from a new network or every login.
Account enumeration: author archives, the REST users route, oEmbed and sitemaps, login error messages.
Exposed surface: XML-RPC, pingbacks and trackbacks, security headers and HSTS, the file editor of the admin.
Journal and statistics: which logins and account changes are recorded, and for how long the journal and the statistics are kept.
